texts: When the Council convenes, the Council redistributes mire-essence across the lantern-stations.
Whenever the Council meets, the Council reallocates mire-essence among the lantern-stations.
Productive stations contribute mire-essence to a central pool.
Burdened stations draw mire-essence from the central pool.
The Keepers record the redistribution in the Watch ledgers.

fields.sentence: When the Council convenes, the Council redistributes mire-essence across the lantern-stations.
parse: (: whenever_convene_redistribute (Implication (And (Member $e1 convene) (Agent $e1 sk_council_1)) (And (Member (sk_redistribute $e1) redistribute) (Agent (sk_redistribute $e1) sk_council_1) (Theme (sk_redistribute $e1) mire_essence) (Across (sk_redistribute $e1) sk_lantern_stations_1) (During (sk_redistribute $e1) $e1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: bare "when P, Q" whose participants are definite/specific but whose tense marks a habitual regularity rather than a one-off narrative — the routing rule keys only on referent definiteness, and its two guards point opposite ways here ("never invents a rule over specific individuals" vs "never leaves a genuine regularity unquantified")
review.notes: "the Council" correctly takes the capitalized-common-noun default (Member, no Name) and, as a singular collective, does not distribute; the sk_council_1 premise constant is licensed because its typing is asserted at top level, mirroring the sk_bell_1 example. Across is the licensed preposition-named oblique, mire_essence the bare kind filler for a non-specific mass object, and the definite plural "the lantern-stations" correctly takes a group witness.

fields.sentence: Whenever the Council meets, the Council reallocates mire-essence among the lantern-stations.
parse: (: whenever_meet_realloc (Implication (And (Member $e_meet meet) (Agent $e_meet sk_council_1)) (And (Member (sk_realloc $e_meet) reallocate) (Agent (sk_realloc $e_meet) sk_council_1) (Theme (sk_realloc $e_meet) mire_essence) (Among (sk_realloc $e_meet) sk_stations_1) (During (sk_realloc $e_meet) $e_meet))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Shape matches the whenever exemplar exactly; 'the Council' correctly stays a common-noun witness with no Name atom and no distribution (singular collective), both hyphenated compounds carry their genus with the noun modifiers unexposed, and Among is a licensed preposition-named oblique rather than a near-fit Goal/Recipient. Only nit: the Skolem stem is sk_realloc rather than the sk_<verb> lemma sk_reallocate — a naming-convention slip with no semantic effect.

fields.sentence: Productive stations contribute mire-essence to a central pool.
parse: (: station_contribute (Implication (And (Member $x station) (Member $x productive)) (And (Member (sk_contribute $x) contribute) (Agent (sk_contribute $x) $x) (Theme (sk_contribute $x) mire_essence) (Recipient (sk_contribute $x) sk_pool_1))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

review.notes: The adjectivally-restricted bare-plural subject correctly forces the distributing-rule route with "productive" as a premise conjunct rather than a fused compound kind, and "a central pool" is taken as the shared existential constant (the natural-meaning reading) with its typing asserted at top level. mire_essence gets its head genus with the noun modifier suppressed, and the transfer "to" goal is Recipient.

fields.sentence: Burdened stations draw mire-essence from the central pool.
parse: (: stations_draw (Implication (And (Member $x station) (Member $x burdened)) (And (Member (sk_draw $x) draw) (Agent (sk_draw $x) $x) (Theme (sk_draw $x) mire_essence) (Source (sk_draw $x) sk_pool_1))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

review.notes: The adjectivally-restricted kind subject correctly forces the distributing-rule route with 'burdened' as a premise conjunct; central_pool follows the east_wing/upper_deck positional-modifier decomposition and the definite pool stays a top-level witness constant.

fields.sentence: The Keepers record the redistribution in the Watch ledgers.

q2_gaps: A capitalized COMMON noun premodifying a common-noun head ("the Watch ledgers"). The instruction set covers a proper-noun premodifier (parse the head normally, link with opaque `Possession`, emit the modifier's `Name`) and, separately, a capitalized common noun used as a referent's ONLY label (common noun by default, no `Name` atom) — but not a capitalized common noun in premodifier position, where those two rules pull toward `Possession` + `Name` on one side and a `watch_ledger` compound with a suppressed noun modifier on the other.
review.notes: `record` is correctly a mere-recording verb (Theme, object unchanged), the definite plural "the ledgers" takes a group witness, the definite "the redistribution" a typed witness, "in …" the event `Location`, and the simple-present habitual no status atom. The only judgment call is treating "Watch" as a name, which is the gap above rather than a defect.
